description: When you began the sinister path into occultism, you never imagined you'd be alchemically altering truckstop Viagra into combat drugs.  But here you are, no sleep til Boston.

use_action.activation_message: You swallow a couple of the large green pills.

description: The morning ritual of the pre-apocalyptic world, created from coffee cherries through a complex process of seed removal, roasting, grinding, and brewing.  Well, that's true for regular coffee, but this doesn't look regular.  It's so coffee is so dark it seems to dim the light around it and its aroma fills the entire room.

effect.u_message: You drink the coffee.  It may be the most bitter thing you've ever drunk.

name: snaring pentagram trap
description: A metallic pentagram full of mystic symbols.  Will trap creatures from other dimensions if they wander into it.
